Salon Policies

 

We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes prior to your appointment to fully enjoy your service.Please call 48 hours in advance for cancellations.
Appointments for 3 hours or more must be secured with a credit card. Cancellations with less than 48 hours notice may necessitate a 50% charge, and less than 24 hours notice, a 100% charge of the reserved services.
Discounts and specials may not be applied to gift card purchases.
All children must be accompanied by an adult.
Individuals must be 18 years or older to receive a full body massage.
We accept the following forms of payment: cash, check, American Express, Visa, and MasterCard.
Gratuities are not accepted on credit card purchases. 
All prices and services are subject to change without notice.
